measurements.particle_name: carboxylated polystyrene nanoplastics PS-C-NPLs (30, 50 and 100 nm)
measurements.evidence_quote: Surface charge analysis (Figure 1D) showed modest differences in Milli-Q water (-32.5 to -52.3 mV), but in EGM-2 all PS-C-NPLs displayed comparable ζ-potentials (-8.2 to -10.1 mV), consistent with previous observations (Santos et al., 2011; Paget et al., 2015; Banerjee et al., 2021). || For colloidal behaviour, PS-C-NPLs (100 μg/mL) were suspended in both Milli-Q water and EGM-2. || Particle size and Z-potential were measured using a Zetasizer® Ultra (Malvern Panalytical, Cambridge, UK) with appropriate cuvettes.
measurements.evidence_location: Results, Physicochemical characterization of PS-C-NPLs; Methods, PS-C-NPLs characterization
